errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted alphabetically by country name. They are sorted in ascending order based on the total height of the bars (the total value).
The description fails to mention the most significant organizational feature of the chart: that the countries on the x-axis are sorted by the total value of their bars in ascending order.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са изобразени със същите цветове за всички държави, като всеки стълб е съставен от пет слоя, които се натрупват един върху друг, като всеки слой представлява една година.
errors.evidence: The description is highly repetitive. It states multiple times that each bar is composed of five stacked layers representing the years. This sentence adds no new information and is redundant.
The legend is located at the bottom center of the chart, not in the bottom right corner.
